data.name: Polandball: The Black Apocalypse
data.detailed_description:
Game Overview

When the lab doors reopen, sealed forbidden entities awaken, unleashing an irreversible catastrophe. An unknown force escapes, corroding flesh, warping minds, materializing fear into tangible nightmares. As apocalyptic shadows engulf Europe, life's whispers fade from the night, leaving only creeping death in silence. None know where this ends, but your choices decide humanity's final fate.

The story unfolds subtly through environmental details, scattered notes, and NPC dialogues. Players must actively explore and piece together fragmented clues to reveal the truth hidden in darkness.

Scavenge limited resources (food, medicine, weapons, parts) for survival. Battle monsters with varied weapons – every second lived is a precious struggle. Protect yourself from being consumed by the all-devouring darkness.

High risk promises high reward: rare supplies and key plot clues hide in perilous zones guarded by powerful foes. Charge ahead or evade cautiously? The choice is yours. Manage resources wisely – minor mistakes may snowball into disaster. Survive. Live to unveil the truth.

Gameplay Flow

Semi-open "diorama" exploration with progressive map unlocking. Danger lurks in unseen corners – advance through combat, puzzles, and story dialogue. Warning: Some areas become inaccessible if missed; every choice alters your journey.

Unique Mechanics

Sustained psychological pressure via dark, isolating environments (e.g., twisted monsters, bloodied scenes, screen glitches).

Dynamic light radius affects visibility – darkness constantly tests your courage. Ambient sounds (wind, creature whispers) and adaptive music build suffocating tension, making fear omnipresent. Events directly impact SAN values; at critical thresholds, triggers activate (e.g., Otherworld rooms, branching dialogues, ghost spawns). Stay vigilant – don't let nightmares drag you into the abyss.

More to Discover

Further surprises await. Secrets remain... Wishlist now and join us to unveil the final mystery!

data.short_description: This game blends Polandball's dark humor with psychological horror and survival combat. Scavenge limited resources (food, medicine, weapons, parts) to stay alive, fend off monsters with diverse arsenals. Every second of survival is a hard-won luxury – survive until you unveil the truth.
